title: Catalog onboarding: sticky help & pin edge-cases (wire notes)
summary: Working notes for a lightweight onboarding experience in the model catalog that surfaces contextual help, introduces pinning semantics during endpoint creation, and handles edge cases (mixed model families, quantization variants, region mismatches). Includes wireframe copy drafts, microcopy for tooltips and modals, and a groomed backlog of follow-ups.
body:
Purpose:
- Reduce first-time friction for engineers that discover a model in the catalog and want to create an endpoint in one flow.
- Make pin semantics explicit at the moment of endpoint creation so users understand behavior across rollback, fallback, and Dedicated/Private variants.
- Surface minimal, inline help (sticky) rather than forcing a full modal walkthrough.

Audience:
- Product/Platform engineers: want to pin a model for predictable behavior.
- Solutions/SEs: need copy they can drop into proposals.

High-level flow (one-page mental model):
1) Catalog search -> results grid
2) Hover/expand model card -> quick metrics + single-line compatibility hint (regions, quant levels)
3) Click "Create endpoint" from card -> compact endpoint drawer (not full page)
4) Endpoint drawer shows: name, route, selected model + version selector, pin toggle with short explanation, small affordance for rollouts/canary
5) On pin toggle open: microcopy + 2 small choices: "Pin exact version" | "Pin major (auto-minor updates)"
6) Confirmation toast with link to rollout controls and a place to edit pin later in Endpoint settings

Wireframe/text notes (visual approximations):
- Catalog grid: left edge has filters, top shows region + latency budget pill. Each model card: title, star rating, tokens/sec (approx), preview sample. Right side of card has two buttons: "Create endpoint" (primary) and a kebab for more actions.
- Hover expansion: show tiny badge: "Pinned by you" or "Pinned (org)" when applicable.
- Endpoint drawer: 3-column stacked layout: name/route on top, model selector in middle, pin + rollout below. Footer contains "Create" and "Cancel".

Copy drafts (single-line, tooltip, and modal copy):
- Catalog search placeholder: "Search models, e.g. llama-2-70b, embeddings, code models"
- Model card brief: "LLM family • 70B • 8-bit quantized • GA"
- Create endpoint button: "Create endpoint (preview)" for beta features; otherwise just "Create endpoint"
- Pin toggle label: "Pin model version"
- Pin toggle tooltip: "Pinning locks the exact model version used by this endpoint. Useful for stability; unpin to receive compatible updates."
- Pin options subtext: "Exact version = reproducible outputs. Major pin = allow compatible minor swaps for perf/cost."
- Canary microcopy: "Enable canary to route a % of traffic to a new variant; automatic fallback included."
- Incompatible variant message (inline error): "Selected variant not compatible with chosen region/hardware. Pick a compatible variant or select fallback policy."

Edge cases + proposed UX handling:
- Mixed-family fallback: if endpoint is pinned to a major family but a model family is removed from catalog, show rollback guidance and a suggested replacement with estimated perf delta.
- Quantization mismatch: warn when chosen variant requires different serving runtime (32-bit vs quantized). Offer to create a paired endpoint with auto-proxying for smooth migration.
- Region mismatch: block create with clear callout: "Model not available in selected region. Use cross-region fallback or choose a different model."
- Org-wide pin conflicts: show small banner when user-level pin deviates from org pin; CTA: "Open org pin settings"

Accessibility and micro-interactions:
- All toggles keyboard-focusable; aria labels include expanded state and short rationale.
- Toast confirmation should include an "Undo" for 10s.
- Animated pin state change should be subtle (0.14s) and not cause layout shift.

Backlog / grooming list (pri ordering):
1) (P0) Endpoint drawer wireframes + prototyping (design + FE) — PROJ-315
2) (P0) Pin metadata in API payload (backend) — ENG-2012
3) (P1) Canary % slider microcopy A/B tests — add PR/experiment
4) (P1) Org-level pin conflict banner design and permission checks
5) (P2) Inline catalog hints for quant/compat that query model metadata at list-time
6) (P2) Cross-region fallback UX copy + telemetry events

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should the default pin behavior be "off" (user must opt-in) or "on" for endpoints created from catalog? Recommendation: default OFF for discoverability, suggest pin in drawer with an explanation.
- Do we allow pin edits on a pinned endpoint without a new deployment? UX recommendation: require explicit redeploy when pin is changed; keep edit flow simple: "Change pin -> Preview impact -> Redeploy".
- How granular are pins (exact build hash vs semantic version)? For now, semantic version + build metadata in backend. UX will show both simple (v1.2.3) and advanced (build 0a4f) in an "advanced details" expander.

Suggested copy experiments (what to A/B):
- Tooltip length for pin toggle: short (current) vs extended (include small example)
- Confirmation tone: "Pinned" vs "Version locked"
- Canary CTA text: "Start canary" vs "Try variant"

Follow-ups (owners + rough ETA):
- Prototype interactive drawer (Design owner: Arjun Patel) — 2 sprints
- Backend API contract for pin metadata (Owner: Diego Morales) — 3 sprints
- Copy review & localization prep (Owner: Maya Chen + Commns) — 1 sprint

Quick notes for product review meeting:
- Demo the drawer prototype and the catalog hover states.
- Bring staging data for a quantization mismatch case so reviewers can see the warning.
- Decision needed on default pin toggle state

Appendix: Quick draft UI strings for localization team:
- "Pin model version"
- "Locks exact version for reproducible outputs"
- "Allow compatible minor updates"
- "Region not supported for selected variant"
- "Enable canary (route % traffic to new variant)"

End of notes.

Action items (short):
- [ ] Design: build drawer prototype (Arjun)
- [ ] Eng: API spec for pinning metadata + schema (Diego)
- [ ] PM: finalize default pin behavior and record decision (Maya)
- [ ] UX writer: finalize tooltips and toasts + add linelength variants for i18n (Priya)
